result.summary: Found 3 visual issues: overlapping unreadable delivery text under Tokumaru Ramen Bar, bottom card content hidden behind tab bar, and inconsistent favorite button styling.

issues.description: Delivery info under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' is garbled/overlapping - reads as '25-30rdelivery' with delivery time and delivery fee text stacked on top of each other, making it unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Fix layout collision so time ('25-30 min') and fee are separate, non-overlapping elements with proper spacing, e.g. '25-30 min 20 delivery 9 Ramen' on one line

issues.description: Second card in 'Popular right now' (pizza image) is clipped directly behind the bottom tab bar with no padding, content is obscured by Home/Search/Orders/Profile navigation.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding / safe-area inset so scrollable content ends above the tab bar and is not hidden underneath it

issues.description: Favorite heart button on Tokumaru Ramen Bar card has no circular dark background/scrim while the pizza card below does, causing inconsistent styling.
issues.suggestion: Apply consistent circular dark scrim/background to all favorite heart buttons for visibility and touch-target consistency
